compute_classification_metrics: compute standard unary classification metrics including cross entropy and top one accuracy over predictions
create_classification_metrics_namedtuple: create a ClassificationMetrics NamedTuple to store cross entropy, top one accuracy, and top five accuracy
compute_top_n_correct: compute the number of predictions where the correct class falls within the top n largest logits
compute_softmax_cross_entropy: compute softmax cross entropy for unnormalized logits using jax and optax with one-hot encoded targets
review_classification_metrics_module: review the classification metrics module for unary classification tasks with top one and top five accuracy
